evidence.claim: Project call is PEO/76, P08, ESO4.5, less-developed regions.
The evaluator explicitly required own needs analysis using studies/analyses/statistics and/or own research.
Target-group nature and size must be clear and quantified and categories delimited geographically and by needs.
Historical needs analysis identifies six explicit problems/needs.
Historical survey sample is 241 pupils.
CF target-group section states survey sample is 200 pupils.
A detailed CF activity narrative again states survey sample is 241 pupils.
Historical survey narrative says practice stages are highly beneficial: 144 large extent, 82 medium, 15 small.
Several questionnaire charts display repeated 86/105/50 values, inconsistent with adjacent narrative values.
Historical analysis says survey involved grades IX-XI but project selection base is described as grades X-XII.
Historical analysis describes a base of 348 pupils in automation/telecom/computing/electrotechnics/environment specializations.
Current CF v28 describes a base of 274 pupils and qualifications including auto mechanics, CNC, machinery, auto electrician, installations and transport technician.
Youth employment rate 15-24 was 24.7% in 2019 vs EU-27 33.4% as used by the historical analysis.
Vâlcea had 4,828 registered unemployed in Jan 2023, including 754 under 25 and 440 aged 25-29.
In 2023 Vâlcea unemployment rate ended at 3.42%, with 4,757 registered unemployed; 270 unemployment entries were graduates.
INS TEMPO exposes county-level school-population and labour-force series suitable for local benchmark reconstruction.
Ministry of Education official archive contains annual pre-university reports including 2021-2022 and 2022-2023.
CRPE published a study on work-based learning in Romanian VET and an agricultural-school practice model.
The historical analysis generalizes agricultural-school evidence to a non-agricultural technical-school target without explicit transferability test.
ADR Sud-Vest Oltenia RIS3 2021-2027 identifies transport systems, industrial engineering/materials, ICT/digitalization and green/circular economy among regional specialization areas/principles.
evidence.source: ADR Sud-Vest Oltenia official RIS3 page

evidence.claim: The historical analysis contains generic preschool-focused text unrelated to the IPT high-school target group.
Historical analysis intro names the proposal 'Colegiul Energetic – stagii de practica pentru elevi' although benchmark project is Pleșoianu.
Current CF justification contains 'Liceul Constantin Brancoveanu' as the study-case school while the project partner is Pleșoianu.
Need for discrimination/nondiscrimination education is listed as an observed problem, but the displayed pupil questionnaire contains no direct discrimination measure.
